description: This file defines the interface for rbus message handling, including message structure, options, callback types, and functions for adding/removing listeners and sending messages within the rbus publish/subscribe system.

methods.name: rbusMessage_AddListener
methods.description: Adds a message listener for a specific topic or expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a message listener for a specific topic or expression.

methods.name: rbusMessage_Send
methods.description: Sends a message with specified options.
